summary: Blocked as unverifiable: the frozen Gong cha packet identifies only the national chain and contains no location, while the official catalog explicitly states that product availability depends on location and the ordering application requires store selection. No binding current catalog can therefore be assigned to these 205 rows. All rows are preserved as location mismatches, and the official chain warning that bubble tea products may contain or contact milk, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, and gluten remains recorded without asserting item-level absence.
